name: 灯
detailed_description:
• Legend has it that in a small isolated mountain village, there is an evil Buddha, and whenever someone makes a wish in front of the temple, a candle will be lit, and under the flickering candlelight, there is the white bones of Sensen. In order to complete the fieldwork, Ruan Qing, a student majoring in folklore, went to a remote mountain village, but he never thought that he would be involved in one murder after another......

Game background

  • It is a closed mountain village, and the people in the village are living happily. Behind the seemingly calm daily life, there is a strange atmosphere everywhere.

  • Under the recommendation of the senior sister, Ruan Qing, a college student, came to the mountain village, and mysterious legends followed one after another. The fog slowly lifted, and the village's past gradually surfaced.

Game characters

  • You'll explore from the perspective of Ruan Qing, a university student. As an outsider who seems to have nothing to do with the village, you get a glimpse of the whole story and get into the game at some point.

  • Each character has their own story, and they are ordinary characters who are also indispensable.

Game Story

  • It's a bizarre story. Under the color of oriental mysticism, layers of suspicion unfold.

  • This is an era filled with myths and spirits. It seems that everyone has an inexplicable reverence for it. As an outsider, can you hold onto your beliefs amidst the chaotic currents?

  • This is a brand new world. Here, one can glimpse its hidden secrets and witness the passage of time.

short_description: 《Falling Light》is a suspenseful game with Chinese horror. In a remote small village, there stands an evil Buddha statue. To do research for her studies in folkloristics, college student Ruan Qing arrives in this distant village, only to find herself entangled in a series of deadly mysteries...
